content: Overfitting nuance beyond parameter-count DOF: 'implicit fitting' - even disciplined researchers make subjective structural choices (which indicator family, which rule shape, which data-cleaning exclusion) informed by having already seen historical outcomes, contaminating the test without any explicit re-tuning loop. Walk-forward alone is also reported to have weaker false-discovery control than combinatorial purged CV in recent work, i.e. walk-forward is necessary but not sufficient - it is not a magic overfitting cure by itself.
